relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: a potent and selective NaV1.8 inhibitor for clinical use in acute pain

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of 10 mg/kg significantly attenuated thermal hypersensitivity post-injection

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily administration over 11 days consistently alleviated hypersensitivity without the appearance of analgesic tolerance.

key_findings: Suzetrigine inhibits TTX-resistant (NaV1.8) currents in mouse DRG neurons (IC50 0.35 uM) and relieves formalin, CFA and PSNI pain.
Repeated dosing in the PSNI model produced no analgesic tolerance.
